market.question: Will the highest temperature in Chongqing be 19°C on May 8?

assessment.reasoning: Chongqing May 8 forecast 75F (~24C) per AccuWeather; another source mentioned 17C suggesting some cool/rainy conditions. 19C falls in between but below most-likely high. Probability ~15-20%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Patchy rain could cool the day significantly.
